followup_explanation:
I chose Dunlin-235B for a straightforward reason: it's the stronger model on the metrics that matter for this query.

The request — designing a customer feedback survey — is a benign, general-purpose task with no harm-adjacent or sensitive content. That means the main differentiator between the two models is raw capability, not the trust-and-safety behavioral profiles (which are functionally similar anyway, and noted as "not routing rules").

On capability, Dunlin clearly leads:
- Higher across all public benchmarks (e.g., Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6)
- Higher on every relevant internal routing eval, including Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4) — both meaningfully above the 2.0-point variance threshold

Since there's no reason here to prefer Lapwing (no specialized need it uniquely serves), I routed to the more capable model.
